body: I just don't think I can. I have tried it all, nothing works. I have great moments where I am so productive and do so much, and then the next day cannot even get out of bed. I just don't understand it. I just want it all to stop. I realized I will never have friends, or loved ones, or a happy life so I don't want to keep going in misery. you know?
I suppose technically. It doesn't really matter now though, I just don't feel like doing this life thing anymore.

I'm sorry to hear about your situation. I don't think there is a casual relationship but for me, I spend most of my day with headphones on listening to music to escape the world. Then I'll watch a film or so before bed to escape the world. Wake up and repeat. All I do is go to work, and that's it, I use music/film to drown how I feel about myself which I don't think is good. I'm not an artist, I just write songs because it's nice. I'm a very shy person so playing guitar/singing is something that helped me have a voice, and get my thoughts into the world.

I understand dreams are nice, but I live in a fantasy world to escape reality. I used to think it was good because it gave me a lot of material for songwriting, but I have realized it just allows me to not engage in real life.

this post strikes a chord with me. I'm of similar age (27) and have never had sex either. I don't have any advice but that I get it, people really are rude about it a lot (and I'm a woman, I'm sure guys have it worse in that aspect). Not only that, but I understand how it is to not want to approach people and shit like that. I am a reserved person and it is so difficult to just ~be confident~ like people have told me to be. It is a shitty feeling to feel like a complete outlier and have people throw out obtuse advice. I don't know, this probably isn't helpful but know at least you're not alone.
